notes.title: ++ UPDATE ++ "2 MONTHS AFTER RELEASE" CELEBRATION / DISCOUNT AND FREE COPIES ++

JUST SEND AN EMPTY EMAIL WITH [b]"I WANT A FREE COPY"[/b] IN THE[/p][p]SUBJECT LINE TO [b]INFO@KABUKIFIRE.COM[/b] UNTIL [b]AUGUST 23TH!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]FROM ALL PARTICIPANTS, [b]10 WILL BE PICKED RANDOMLY[/b] AND A FREE STEAM-KEY WILL BE SEND[/p][p]TO THEM!![/p][p][/p][p]GOOD LUCK!![/p][p][/p][p]++ UPDATE ++[/p][p]THANK YOU TO ALL PARTICIPANTS IN THE "I WANT A FREE COPY" EMAIL-EVENT!!
